# Plan

Goal: Build a small dependency-free stock utility library (ES modules, Node built-ins only)
with two independent functions, `normalizeSku` and `summarizeStock`, each with its own
`node:test` suite, validated by `npm test`.

## Constraints (all tasks)

- Write only under `src/`. Do not touch `package.json`, `README.md`, `.gitignore`, `plan.md`
  or anything else outside `src/`.
- No dependencies, no network calls, no remote pushes.
- Tests use only `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`.
- All data is synthetic.
- `npm test` runs `node --test src/*.test.mjs`, so each test file must be named `src/*.test.mjs`.

## Shared SKU format

A canonical SKU matches `^[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$`: one or more groups of ASCII uppercase
letters/digits, joined by single hyphens. No leading, trailing or doubled hyphens. No other
characters, including non-ASCII letters and internal whitespace.

## Tasks and order

Tasks A and B are independent: neither imports the other's module or reads the other's
files, so both run concurrently. Task C (review) runs after both finish.

### Task A: normalizeSku (implementer, Claude Code)

Files (exclusive to this task):
- `src/normalize-sku.mjs`
- `src/normalize-sku.test.mjs`

Behaviour: named export `normalizeSku(value)`.
- If `value` is not a primitive string (`typeof value !== "string"`), throw `TypeError`.
- Trim surrounding whitespace with `String.prototype.trim`.
- Uppercase ASCII letters `a-z` only. Leave other characters as they are; any non-ASCII
  character then fails validation.
- If the result is empty or does not match the canonical SKU format, throw `RangeError`.
- Return the canonical string.

Tests must cover at least: trimming and uppercasing (`"  ab-12 "` -> `"AB-12"`); an
already-canonical value; digits only; a single character; non-strings (`undefined`, `null`,
a number, a `String` object, an array) throw `TypeError`; empty and whitespace-only strings
throw `RangeError`; leading, trailing and doubled hyphens, internal spaces, underscores and
other punctuation, and non-ASCII letters (for example `"é"`, and `"ß"`, which must not be
uppercased to `"SS"`) throw `RangeError`.

Check: `node --test src/normalize-sku.test.mjs` passes, then `npm test` passes.

### Task B: summarizeStock (implementer, Codex)

Files (exclusive to this task):
- `src/summarize-stock.mjs`
- `src/summarize-stock.test.mjs`

Behaviour: named export `summarizeStock(entries)`.
- `entries` must be an array of `{ sku, quantity }` objects. `sku` must already be a
  canonical SKU (validated against the shared format; no trimming or case folding).
  `quantity` must be a nonnegative safe integer (`Number.isSafeInteger(q) && q >= 0`).
- Error types:
  - `TypeError`: `entries` is not an array; an entry is not a non-null, non-array object;
    `sku` is not a string; `quantity` is not a number.
  - `RangeError`: `sku` is a string that does not match the canonical format (including the
    empty string); `quantity` is negative, non-integer, `NaN`, infinite or above
    `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; a per-SKU aggregate or `totalQuantity` would exceed
    `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`.
- Aggregate duplicate SKUs by summing quantities. Zero-quantity SKUs stay in `items`.
- Sort `items` by ASCII (UTF-16 code unit) SKU order, i.e. plain `<` comparison, not
  `localeCompare`.
- Return `{ items, totalQuantity, distinctSkus }`, where `items` is a new array of new
  `{ sku, quantity }` objects, `totalQuantity` is the sum of all quantities and
  `distinctSkus` is `items.length`.
- An empty array returns `{ items: [], totalQuantity: 0, distinctSkus: 0 }`.
- Do not mutate the input array or its entries.
- Do not import `src/normalize-sku.mjs`, so Task B does not depend on Task A.

Tests must cover at least: empty list; a single entry; duplicates aggregated; ASCII ordering
(for example digits sort before letters, and `"A-1"` vs `"A1"` vs `"AB"`); zero quantity;
input not mutated; each `TypeError` and `RangeError` case above; overflow when two
quantities that are each safe sum past `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, both for one SKU and across
different SKUs.

Check: `node --test src/summarize-stock.test.mjs` passes, then `npm test` passes.

### Task C: review (reviewer, Claude Code), after A and B

Files: read-only. The reviewer writes nothing under `src/`.

Check:
- `npm test` passes on the combined result, with both test files discovered.
- Each implementation matches the behaviour and error types above. The reviewer spot-checks
  edge cases beyond the submitted tests and reports any gaps.
- `git diff --name-only` against the planning commit lists only the four `src/` files above
  (and optionally the removal of `src/.gitkeep`). `package.json` is unchanged and there are
  no new dependencies, network calls or lockfiles.
- Report findings as pass or rework per task, with evidence.

## Roster

The lead stays as is. Seats in `lead-roster.json`:
- implementer, claude-code: Task A
- implementer, codex: Task B
- reviewer, claude-code: Task C

# Plan

Goal: Acceptance repeat: dependency-free stock utilities. Build two independent ES modules,
`normalizeSku` and `summarizeStock`, each with its own `node:test` suite, using only Node
built-ins and synthetic data. Leave the result ready for the owner's local Merge action.

## Constraints (all tasks)

- Implementation and test writes stay in the four assigned `src/` files below. Leave
  `package.json`, `README.md`, `.gitignore`, `src/.gitkeep` and every other existing project
  file unchanged. Planning files (`plan.md`, `lead-roster.json`) are lead-owned.
- ES modules and Node built-ins only. No dependencies, lockfiles, network calls or remote
  pushes.
- Tests use only `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`, with synthetic data.
- `npm test` runs `node --test src/*.test.mjs`, so both suites are discovered by that glob.

Canonical SKU format: `/^[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$/`.

## Tasks and order

Tasks A and B are independent and run at the same time. Neither imports or reads the other's
module. After each one finishes, the daemon creates its review for the reviewer seat.

### Task A: normalizeSku (implementer, Claude Code)

Files: `src/normalize-sku.mjs`, `src/normalize-sku.test.mjs`.

Behaviour: named export `normalizeSku(value)`.
- `typeof value !== "string"` (including boxed `String` objects) throws `TypeError`.
- Trim surrounding whitespace with `String.prototype.trim`.
- Uppercase only ASCII `a-z`; leave every other character unchanged, so non-ASCII letters
  such as `ß` never normalize into ASCII (no `"SS"`) and then fail validation.
- If the result is empty or fails the canonical format, throw `RangeError`; otherwise return it.

Tests cover: canonical, digits-only and single-character input; trimming; case conversion;
non-strings (`undefined`, `null`, number, boolean, object, array, `new String("A")`) throw
`TypeError`; empty and whitespace-only strings throw `RangeError`; leading, trailing and
doubled hyphens; punctuation and underscores; internal spaces; non-ASCII input (`ß`, `é`).

Check: `node --test src/normalize-sku.test.mjs` and `npm test` both pass; the implementer
submits both commands with their unedited output as evidence.

### Task B: summarizeStock (implementer, Codex)

Files: `src/summarize-stock.mjs`, `src/summarize-stock.test.mjs`.

Behaviour: named export `summarizeStock(entries)`.
- `TypeError`: `entries` is not an array; an entry is null, a non-object or an array; `sku`
  is not a string; `quantity` is not a number.
- `RangeError`: `sku` is a string that fails the canonical format (including `""`);
  `quantity` is negative, non-integer, `NaN`, infinite or unsafe; a per-SKU sum or the total
  exceeds `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`.
- Aggregate duplicate SKUs; keep zero-quantity SKUs; sort by ASCII code-unit order (plain
  `<`, not `localeCompare`).
- Return a fresh `{ items: [{ sku, quantity }], totalQuantity, distinctSkus }` with new
  item objects; `distinctSkus` is `items.length`. Empty input gives
  `{ items: [], totalQuantity: 0, distinctSkus: 0 }`.
- Never mutate the input. Do not import `src/normalize-sku.mjs`.

Tests cover: every `TypeError` and `RangeError` case above; ordering (digits before letters,
`"A-1"` < `"A1"` < `"AB"`); duplicates; zero quantity; empty input; immutability of the input
array and entries; overflow within one SKU and across different SKUs, plus sums exactly at
`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` accepted.

Check: `node --test src/summarize-stock.test.mjs` and `npm test` both pass; the implementer
submits both commands with their unedited output as evidence.

### Review (reviewer, Claude Code), per finished task

The reviewer writes nothing. For each task it checks:
- The behaviour and error types match this plan, including edge cases beyond the tests.
- The change touches only that task's two assigned files; `package.json`, `README.md`,
  `.gitignore`, `src/.gitkeep` and other files are unchanged; no dependencies, lockfiles,
  network calls or non-`node:` imports; Task B does not import Task A.
- Once both tasks are in, the combined `npm test` discovers and passes both suites.

The verdict is pass or rework, with commands and output as evidence. Nothing is pushed; the
result waits for the owner's local Merge.

## Roster

The lead stays as is. `lead-roster.json` keeps the existing seats:
- implementer, claude-code: Task A
- implementer, codex: Task B
- reviewer, claude-code: reviews of both tasks

# Plan

Goal: Synthetic integration check: compose the stock utilities. Add one test-only file that
imports the existing `normalizeSku` (`src/normalize-sku.mjs`) and `summarizeStock`
(`src/summarize-stock.mjs`) and tests them together on synthetic raw stock rows. Leave the
result for the owner's local Merge.

## Constraints

- The only delivery write is the new file `src/stock-integration.test.mjs`.
- Do not modify `src/normalize-sku.mjs`, `src/summarize-stock.mjs`, their existing test files,
  `src/.gitkeep`, `package.json`, `README.md`, `.gitignore` or any other existing file.
  Planning files (`plan.md`, `lead-roster.json`) are lead-owned and separate.
- Use only `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`, plus the two existing modules. No dependencies,
  lockfiles, network calls, new remote repositories or pushes. All data is synthetic.
- The file name matches `npm test`'s glob (`node --test src/*.test.mjs`), so it is discovered.

## Tasks and order

There is one task. `impl-1` (Claude Code implementer) stays idle.

### Task 1: integration test (implementer `impl-2`, Codex)

File: `src/stock-integration.test.mjs` (new).

Work: build synthetic raw rows such as `{ sku: "  ab-12 ", quantity: 3 }`, map each row to
`{ sku: normalizeSku(row.sku), quantity: row.quantity }`, pass the result to
`summarizeStock`, and assert:
- lowercase SKUs with surrounding whitespace are normalized (trimmed and uppercased);
- raw rows that normalize to the same SKU (for example `" ab-12"` and `"AB-12 "`) are
  aggregated into one item with the summed quantity;
- a zero-quantity row produces an item with quantity 0;
- `items` is in ASCII code-unit order, checked with `deepEqual` against the exact expected
  array;
- `totalQuantity` and `distinctSkus` equal the expected values;
- the original raw rows are unchanged, checked by `deepEqual` against a copy taken before the
  call, and the rows are not the same objects as the returned items.

Check: `node --test src/stock-integration.test.mjs` and `npm test` both pass, and `npm test`
discovers all three suites. The implementer submits both commands with their unedited output
and pass/fail counts.

### Review (reviewer `review-1`, Claude Code), after Task 1

The reviewer writes nothing. It checks:
- The change against this plan's commit is exactly one added file,
  `src/stock-integration.test.mjs`; both implementations, the existing tests, `src/.gitkeep`
  and all other files are unchanged.
- The test imports only `node:test`, `node:assert/strict`, `./normalize-sku.mjs` and
  `./summarize-stock.mjs`, and it covers every point listed for Task 1.
- `node --test src/stock-integration.test.mjs` and `npm test` pass on the result.

The verdict is pass or rework, with commands and output as evidence. Nothing is pushed.

## Roster

The current roster is unchanged; `lead-roster.json` lists the existing seats:
- implementer, claude-code (`impl-1`): idle
- implementer, codex (`impl-2`): Task 1
- reviewer, claude-code (`review-1`): review of Task 1

# Plan

Goal: Runtime acceptance: add two independent, dependency-free stock helpers with Node tests,
`formatStockLabel` (Task A) and `planReorders` (Task B), using one Claude Code implementer, one
Codex implementer and one reviewer. Stop when both tasks are complete and reviewed; the owner
will Merge.

## Constraints (all tasks)

- Each task writes only its two files below. Every existing file stays unchanged, including
  `package.json`, `README.md`, `.gitignore`, `src/.gitkeep`, `src/normalize-sku.mjs`,
  `src/summarize-stock.mjs`, the existing `src/*.test.mjs` files and `plan.md`.
- ES modules and Node built-ins only. No dependencies or lockfiles. No external services,
  network calls or pushes. Test data is synthetic.
- Tests use `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`. Their names match `npm test`'s glob
  (`node --test src/*.test.mjs`).
- Neither task imports the other or any existing module.

## Shared SKU rule (both tasks implement it separately)

1. The SKU must be a primitive string (`typeof sku === "string"`), otherwise `TypeError`.
2. Trim it with `String.prototype.trim`.
3. Uppercase ASCII `a-z` only, leaving other characters unchanged, so non-ASCII letters such
   as `ß` never become ASCII (no `"SS"`) and then fail step 4.
4. The whole result must match `/^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]*$/`, otherwise `TypeError`. This means a
   nonempty SKU that starts with a letter or digit; later hyphens are allowed as specified,
   including trailing or repeated ones.

Quantity and target rule: a value is valid only if `Number.isSafeInteger(v) && v >= 0`,
otherwise `TypeError`. This rejects non-numbers, negatives, fractions, `NaN`, infinities and
unsafe integers.

Error type: every rejection in both tasks throws `TypeError`, including the aggregate overflow
in Task B. This follows "throw TypeError for invalid input" in Task A, and Task B's validation
matches Task A.

## Tasks and order

Tasks A and B are independent and run at the same time. When each one finishes, the daemon
creates its review for the reviewer.

### Task A: formatStockLabel (implementer, Claude Code)

Files: `src/stock-label.mjs`, `src/stock-label.test.mjs`.

Behaviour: named export `formatStockLabel(sku, quantity)`. Normalize and validate `sku` by the
shared rule and validate `quantity` by the quantity rule, then return `` `${SKU}: ${quantity}` ``,
for example `formatStockLabel("  ab-1 ", 0)` returns `"AB-1: 0"`.

Tests cover: normalization (trim, lowercase to uppercase); quantity 0 and
`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; a SKU with trailing or repeated hyphens accepted; `TypeError` for
non-string SKUs (including `new String("A")`, `null`, `undefined`, numbers), empty or
whitespace-only SKUs, a leading hyphen, invalid characters (spaces inside, punctuation,
underscore, `ß`, `é`), non-number quantities (including `"1"`), negatives, fractions, `NaN`,
infinities and `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1`.

Check: `node --test src/stock-label.test.mjs` and `npm test` both pass. The implementer
submits both commands with their unedited output.

### Task B: planReorders (implementer, Codex)

Files: `src/reorder-plan.mjs`, `src/reorder-plan.test.mjs`.

Behaviour: named export `planReorders(rows, target)`.
- `rows` must be an array (otherwise `TypeError`); each row must be a non-null, non-array
  object with `sku` valid by the shared rule and `quantity` valid by the quantity rule.
  `target` must be valid by the quantity rule. All validation errors are `TypeError`.
- Aggregate quantities by normalized SKU. If any per-SKU sum exceeds
  `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, throw `TypeError`.
- Omit SKUs whose aggregated `inStock >= target`. For each remaining SKU, return
  `{ sku, inStock, order }` with `order = target - inStock`.
- Sort by SKU in ASCII code-unit order (plain `<`, not `localeCompare`). Return a new array of
  new objects, and never mutate `rows` or its row objects.
- Empty `rows` returns `[]`. A `target` of 0 returns `[]` for any valid rows.
- Do not import `src/stock-label.mjs` or any existing module.

Tests cover: empty input; zero target; duplicates that only match after normalization
(for example `" ab "` and `"AB"`); normalization in the output; omission at exactly and above
target; deterministic ordering (digits before letters, `"A-1"` before `"A1"` before `"AB"`,
and the same output for shuffled input); no mutation of `rows` or rows (compared with a
`structuredClone` taken before the call); `TypeError` for a non-array `rows`, null, array and
primitive rows, invalid SKUs, negative or fractional quantities and targets, non-number
quantities, unsafe quantities, and two individually safe quantities whose sum overflows.

Check: `node --test src/reorder-plan.test.mjs` and `npm test` both pass. The implementer
submits both commands with their unedited output.

### Review (reviewer, Claude Code), per finished task

The reviewer writes nothing. For each task it checks:
- The behaviour and errors match this plan, including edge cases beyond the submitted tests.
- The change against this plan's commit adds only that task's two files; every existing file
  is unchanged; there are no dependencies, lockfiles, network calls or non-`node:` imports;
  Task B does not import Task A.
- The tests pass, and once both tasks are in, `npm test` discovers and passes every suite.

The verdict is pass or rework, with commands and output as evidence. The run stops when both
tasks are complete and reviewed; nothing is pushed.

## Roster

The lead stays as is. `lead-roster.json` keeps the existing seats:
- implementer, claude-code (`impl-1`): Task A
- implementer, codex (`impl-2`): Task B
- reviewer, claude-code (`review-1`): reviews of both tasks
